localizedValues.name: G1-Horseshoe Bend
localizedValues.description: This site has a shelter and is situated beside Cowichan River amongst the trees. There are 11 tent pads. Parking is in a gravel lot above the site. Vehicles are only allowed to drop off at the shelter and then have to park in the lot. Campers and RV's can camp in the parking lot. The shelter has a sink, wood stoves inside the shelter and picnic tables inside and out. Water is available by a water pump in the group site. Cowichan River is beside the site so watch small children. The river can be dangerous certain times of the year; especially in winter, fall or spring. This is a very private site and beautifully situated.
This is a first-come, first-served campsite. Site availability can only be confirmed in-person, at the park

localizedValues.name: G2-Stoltz Pool
localizedValues.description: The Stolz Pool groupsite is an inland location with an open area inclusive of RV and tent camping. Parking is in a gravel lot beside the tent pads. Campers and RV’s can camp in the parking lot. There are 2 pit toilets and garbage and recycling facilities at the groupsite. The groupsite has an open air shelter that can fit 4 picnic tables. The firepit is located beside the shelter.
This is a first-come, first-served campsite. Site availability can only be confirmed in-person, at the park
